An '''individual''' [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] the [[palace guard corps]] that protected the [[Whitestone City palace|palace]] of the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" /> Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] accident believed to have been orchestrated by their successor, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Pakrie]].<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pakrie's predecessor was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
